deploymentOrder.note: Deployment does not make the adapter or its source canonical.

postDeployment: retain exact runtime code hashes and constructor dependency addresses
configure providers, feeds, sources and risk policy only through governance
run canonical-read smoke tests before consumers are enabled
retain registry publication transaction and testnet qualification evidence

interfaceAuthority.rule: The frozen v1.0 Genesis interface is retained as historical compatibility authority and must not be imported by OracleRouter420 or treated as the runtime 420Oracle V1 ABI. Any migration of the frozen interface requires the interface-layer major-version process.

testnetBlockers: external provider credentials and operator infrastructure
